skill.name: xhs-creator-collaboration-evaluation
skill.description: 用户提供品牌或产品、目标受众、候选小红书达人和预算时，使用蒲公英报价、粉丝画像和内容表现比较合作适配度，交付候选对照表与待确认事项。SocialDataX 支持命令查询；不预测实际成交或投放回报。
skill.summary: Compare Xiaohongshu creator quotes, audience fit, and content performance against a campaign brief and budget.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts came from Markdown formatting, creator lookup flags, or Chinese prose. The live CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package with access to service credentials, and its shell examples do not specify safe argument handling. Troubleshooting also relies on a billing link from a service response; no evidence of credential theft or an embedded prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: The authentication and lookup commands run a mutable npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed release pinned to an exact version with verified integrity. Require approval before installing or running it.

remediation.issue: The CLI can access an environment credential or a persistent credential file.
remediation.suggestion: Give the reviewed CLI only the service credential it needs. Prefer a system secret store and document any supported legacy variables.

remediation.issue: Shell examples place user-controlled values directly in command text.
remediation.suggestion: Pass inputs as separate arguments without invoking a shell. Validate creator IDs and extract only recognized profile URLs from share text.

remediation.issue: Billing guidance can relay a URL from an error response.
remediation.suggestion: Use only the fixed SocialDataX billing address and do not forward billing links from error responses. Resume paid requests only after user confirmation.

content.value_statement: Creator quotes, audience data, and content metrics are hard to compare across a shortlist. Evaluate each candidate against the same campaign brief and budget.
actual_capabilities: Resolve a Xiaohongshu profile link to a creator ID before requesting commercial data.
Retrieve available Pugongying collaboration quotes and compare them against the campaign budget.
Compare reported follower demographics with the campaign's target audience.
Compare recent note performance using the same scope, such as sponsored notes only.
Produce a shortlist table with source evidence, data gaps, and recommended follow-up.
limitations: Live lookups require an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or MCP connection. Each successful Pugongying query costs 20 credits.
Performance and trend queries use service-defined windows. They do not accept custom date ranges.
Some profiles lack commercial data, and audience breakdowns can be incomplete.
The skill does not contact creators, book collaborations, or predict sales or return on investment.

use_cases.title: Screen a shortlist by budget
use_cases.description: Compare quoted formats and prices before spending credits on deeper audience research.

use_cases.title: Build an audience-fit comparison
use_cases.description: Compare follower demographics and sponsored content performance across approved candidates.

use_cases.title: Check evidence before approving a budget
use_cases.description: Review what the quotes cover and identify missing data or terms that need confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Check which quotes fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen these Xiaohongshu creators for a skincare campaign with a CNY 20,000 budget per creator. Use only quote lookups and ask before spending credits.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a shortlist and need an initial price check.

prompt_templates.title: Compare audience fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two creators for a running shoe launch targeting women aged 25 to 34. Estimate the cost of quote and audience lookups before proceeding.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need evidence of audience fit in addition to quoted price.

prompt_templates.title: Compare sponsored note performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these three creators against my brief and budget. Use sponsored notes only, show the returned windows, and ask before any paid lookup.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to compare prior sponsored content on a consistent basis.

prompt_templates.title: Limit research spending in stages
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a comparison with a 120-credit cap. Check quotes first, then propose audience and sponsored note lookups for budget-fit candidates. Confirm costs before each stage.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to manage research costs and document incomplete results.

output_examples.input: Compare two fictional candidates against a CNY 15,000 cap using quotes only.
output: Creator A: CNY 12,000 for one video. Within budget at the quoted rate. Confirm usage rights and any extra fees.
Creator B: CNY 18,000 for one video. Above budget at the quoted rate.
Audience fit and sponsored performance were not assessed.

output_examples.input: Compare audience fit and sponsored notes for two fictional candidates. The target is women aged 25 to 34.
output: Creator A: The audience report shows that 38% of followers are aged 25 to 34. It does not show age broken down by gender.
Creator B: Commercial data is unavailable. Public profile activity cannot substitute for sponsored performance.
Recommendation: Ask Creator A for a gender breakdown by age. Defer ranking until both candidates have comparable evidence.

best_practices: Provide the campaign goal, target audience, currency, budget, and complete creator IDs or profile links.
Confirm the scope and estimated credits before paid queries. Enter credentials only through an approved local setup or existing authenticated connection.
Compare like formats and data windows. Separate reported figures from recommendations and confirm quotes directly.
anti_patterns: Treating a zero or missing quote as a free collaboration.
Using ordinary profile activity as a substitute for missing commercial metrics.
Running every endpoint by default or claiming a sales forecast from historical engagement.

faq.question: What information do I need to start?
faq.answer: Provide the brand or product, target audience, budget, and the Xiaohongshu IDs or profile links for your shortlist.

faq.question: Does it find new creators for me?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates the candidates you provide and does not expand the shortlist automatically.

faq.question: How do live lookups authenticate?
faq.answer: Use an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or configure the SocialDataX CLI in its execution environment. Do not share your key in chat.

faq.question: How many credits does a lookup cost?
faq.answer: Each successful Pugongying query costs 20 credits. Profile link resolution may incur a separate charge.

faq.question: What happens when commercial data is missing?
faq.answer: The comparison flags the gap and keeps available results. It does not replace missing commercial figures with ordinary profile metrics.

faq.question: Can it contact creators or estimate actual returns?
faq.answer: No. It provides a comparison and questions to verify. It does not message creators, place orders, or predict sales.
